Agric.interprete. Prifciani Caefa-rienfis præexercitamenta,ex Hermogene transla-ta,comentariola in aliquot L.Annei Senecæ declamationes. Epi-ftolæ,inter quas etiam ea quæ feorfim aliquoties impreffa eft,de ftudio formado. Idem congessit plurima vocabula quæ Germani cum Græcis communia habent. Claruit Heydelbergæ, anno Domini 1485, quo etiam obijt.

page.notes: Printed line numbers in the gutter (5, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60) are placed where they stand; the numbers 5 and 6 at the left and 10 to 60 at the right are shown as notes beside the nearest line. The reading "Phriffemij" and "Vualterburgenfis" are uncertain. "Io-Murmelij" at the line end is an uncertain name; the first part is unclear. "Rodolphi Agricolae Vualterburgenfis" is taken from the printed form; the italic setting of names is judged from the scan. The line "Sote-rijs" is a line-end break. The first paragraph and the continuation of "exemplis aliquot / explicata" run across the column break. The "+" and "*" signs are printed marks. Small scan wear at the top edge; no other damage affects the reading.
